race.comment: ATSUI HARU (15) got well back on debut but stuck on nicely at Pinjarra fresh. She rises in weight today as she loses the apprentice hoop, but Pike now takes the ride in a big push for her chances. Expecting her to be closer in the run this time around and sharp improvement is on the cards. NEWHAVEN PRINCE (1) was solid last start at Belmont when fresh from a break, finishing off nicely to be 2.4L off the winner. The slight rise in trip is a bonus, though it's the better barrier that looks to hold the key. Should sit closer this time and a return to his best will see him hard to hold out. SYLVA JACK (2) comes back in trip today where he's been placed 2/3 at this track and distance. A good draw helps and he finds the right race to feature. VAMPI QUEEN (8) has trialled strongly coming into this and looks ready to go to the next level. BOLD FIGHT (3) can improve.
